question.worked_solution:
First, we determine the common ratio $r$ for this geometric series:

$$
\begin{aligned}r & =\frac{{a}_{2}}{{a}_{1}} \\  & =\frac{18}{6} \\  & =3\end{aligned}
$$

The sum of the first $N$ terms of a geometric series can be determined by the formula

$$
{S}_{N}=\frac{{a}_{1}(1-{r}^{N})}{1-r}.
$$

In this case, ${a}_{1}=6$ and $r=3.$ Substituting these values into the formula for ${S}_{N}$ gives the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{S}_{N} & =\frac{6(1-{3}^{N})}{1-3} \\  & =-\frac{6}{2}(1-{3}^{N}) \\  & =3({3}^{N}-1)\end{aligned}
$$
